title: SCM Cost Attribution: Metrics + Dimensions Inventory (Cardinality + Aggregation Proposal)
content:
Doc type: spreadsheet-style (captured as text)
Last pass goal: align runtime + telemetry dims with Standard Cost Model (SCM) v1 without blowing up metric cardinality.
Primary consumers: Cost Model service (attribution inputs), Console cost breakdown (explainability), Optimize (what-if sweeps; estimates only).

--------------------------------------------------------------------
TAB 1 — CANDIDATE METRICS (SCM-RELEVANT)
Columns: metric_name | type | unit | source | scm_use | proposed_dimensions | cardinality_risk | aggregation_strategy | retention | notes

1) scm.request.count | counter | requests | cost-model-service | ops | region, env, endpoint, scm_version, result_status | Low | sum by dims | 30d | Service health; do NOT attach tenant/model.
2) scm.request.latency_ms | histogram | ms | cost-model-service | ops | region, env, endpoint, scm_version, result_status | Low | p50/p95/p99 | 30d | SLO metric.
3) scm.request.validation_error.count | counter | errors | cost-model-service | ops | region, env, error_code, field_name | Med | sum; topK(field_name) | 30d | field_name topK=50; remainder bucket=other.
4) scm.attribution.total_cost_usd | histogram | USD | cost-model-service | scm | deployment_mode, region, gpu_sku, model_family, quant_profile_id, cache_policy | Med | p50/p95 + sum via logs | 14d (metrics), 30-90d (logs) | For audits we rely on event logs (see policy below). Metrics should be coarse.
5) scm.attribution.compute_cost_usd | histogram | USD | cost-model-service | scm | deployment_mode, region, gpu_sku, model_family, quant_profile_id | Med | histogram; also sample exemplars | 14d | Breakdowns in Console should use per-request explain payload; metrics only for monitoring.
6) scm.attribution.memory_cost_usd | histogram | USD | cost-model-service | scm | deployment_mode, region, gpu_sku, model_family, quant_profile_id | Med | histogram | 14d | Memory component can spike for long context; watch p99.
7) scm.attribution.cache_savings_usd | histogram | USD | cost-model-service | scm | deployment_mode, region, cache_type, model_family | Med | histogram | 14d | cache_type in {kv_prefix, kv_full, response_cache? (future)}.
8) scm.attribution.batch_efficiency_ratio | histogram | ratio (0-1+) | runtime/telemetry -> cost-model | scm | region, gpu_sku, model_family, scheduler_profile | Med | histogram | 14d | scheduler_profile MUST be low-cardinality (enum).
9) runtime.tokens.prefill | counter | tokens | serving runtime | scm | region, gpu_sku, model_family, quant_profile_id | Med | sum by dims | 14d | Do not add tenant_id. Model ID is too high; use model_family.
10) runtime.tokens.decode | counter | tokens | serving runtime | scm | region, gpu_sku, model_family, quant_profile_id | Med | sum by dims | 14d | Needed for prefill/decode split and $ attribution.
11) runtime.latency.prefill_ms | histogram | ms | serving runtime | scm | region, gpu_sku, model_family, quant_profile_id | Med | p50/p95/p99 | 14d | Useful for mismatch detectors.
12) runtime.latency.decode_ms | histogram | ms | serving runtime | scm | region, gpu_sku, model_family, quant_profile_id | Med | p50/p95/p99 | 14d | Decode often dominated by batching.
13) runtime.batch_size_effective | histogram | requests/batch | serving runtime | scm | region, gpu_sku, model_family, scheduler_profile | Med | histogram | 14d | batch_size_effective computed post-admission control (see PR-18618).
14) runtime.concurrency.active | gauge | requests | serving runtime | ops | region, gpu_sku, pool_id | Med | avg/max | 14d | pool_id should be small (dedicated pools only); avoid per-tenant pools.
15) runtime.kv_cache.hit_rate | histogram | ratio (0-1) | serving runtime | scm | region, gpu_sku, model_family, cache_scope | Med | histogram | 14d | cache_scope: {request, tenant, global} (proposal). Must remain enum.
16) runtime.kv_cache.bytes_read | counter | bytes | serving runtime | scm | region, gpu_sku, cache_scope | Med | sum by dims | 14d | For memory/bandwidth modeling; validate overhead.
17) runtime.kv_cache.bytes_written | counter | bytes | serving runtime | scm | region, gpu_sku, cache_scope | Med | sum by dims | 14d | If missing, SCM assumes bytes_written=0 and lowers confidence.
18) runtime.quant_profile.active | counter | requests | serving runtime | scm | region, gpu_sku, quant_profile_id, model_family | Med | sum by dims | 14d | quant_profile_id must be stable, low-ish cardinality (see TAB 3).
19) telemetry.signal_missing.count | counter | events | telemetry pipeline | ops/scm | region, env, signal_name, source_service | Med | sum; topK(signal_name) | 30d | Tracks gaps that force SCM assumptions.
20) scm.confidence.score | histogram | score (0-1) | cost-model-service | scm | deployment_mode, region, gpu_sku, model_family, reason_code | Med | histogram; topK(reason_code) | 14d | reason_code enum describing assumption paths.
21) scm.mismatch.estimated_vs_metered_ratio | histogram | ratio | canary harness | ops | region, gpu_sku, model_family, quant_profile_id | Med | p50/p95/p99 | 30d | From perf-canary; alert on drift > threshold.

Explicitly NOT as metric dimensions (move to logs / explain payload only): tenant_id, org_id, user_id, prompt_id, route_id (raw), model_id (full), request_id, ip, api_key_id.

--------------------------------------------------------------------
TAB 2 — DIMENSION INVENTORY + CARDINALITY ESTIMATES
Columns: dimension | description | est_cardinality | risk | policy | normalization

1) env | prod/staging/dev | 3 | Low | allow | fixed enum
2) region | cloud region | 10–30 | Low | allow | canonical region code (e.g., us-east-1)
3) deployment_mode | hosted/dedicated/private | 3 | Low | allow | fixed enum
4) endpoint | /v1/cost/estimate, /v1/cost/explain | 2–5 | Low | allow | fixed enum
5) scm_version | scm/1, scm/2... | 1–5 | Low | allow | semver-major only in metrics
6) result_status | ok/error/partial | 3–5 | Low | allow | fixed enum
7) error_code | INVALID_ARGUMENT, UNSUPPORTED_VERSION, TIMEOUT... | 10–30 | Low | allow | fixed enum
8) field_name | offending field on validation | 20–200 | Med | topK (50) + other | sanitize to schema paths (e.g., inputs.region)
9) gpu_sku | A100-80GB, H100-80GB, L40S... | 10–50 | Med | allow | canonical sku string from model catalog
10) accelerator_vendor | nvidia/amd (future) | 1–3 | Low | allow | enum
11) model_family | e.g., llama, mistral, qwen, gemma | 5–30 | Low | allow | map model_id -> family in catalog
12) model_size_bucket | 7B/13B/34B/70B/8x7B/etc | 5–20 | Low | allow | catalog-derived bucket
13) quant_profile_id | quant profile identifier | 10–200 (expected) | Med | allow with guardrails | must be stable id; cap active profiles per model family (proposal)
14) scheduler_profile | runtime scheduling preset | 3–10 | Low | allow | enum (e.g., latency, balanced, throughput)
15) cache_type | kv_prefix/kv_full/none | 3–6 | Low | allow | enum
16) cache_scope | request/tenant/global | 3 | Low | allow | enum
17) cache_policy | warm/cold/assumed | 3–6 | Low | allow | enum
18) admission_bucket | coarse load bucket | 3–8 | Low | allow | define as {low, med, high} or numeric bucket
19) tenant_tier | free/pro/enterprise (internal) | 3–6 | Med | restrict | only for internal dashboards; no export
20) tenant_hash | hashed tenant id | huge | High | forbid in metrics | only in logs with access controls
21) route_group | low-card grouping of routes | 10–200 | Med | allow with topK | route_group derived from config; no raw route
22) request_shape_bucket | (context_len_bucket x output_len_bucket) | 20–100 | Med | allow | fixed bucketing (see below)

Bucketing proposal (request_shape_bucket):
- context_len_bucket tokens: [0-256, 257-1k, 1k-4k, 4k-16k, 16k+]
- output_len_bucket tokens: [0-128, 129-512, 513-2k, 2k+]
- store combined label, e.g. ctx_1k_4k__out_129_512

--------------------------------------------------------------------
TAB 3 — AGGREGATION / STORAGE STRATEGY (WHAT GOES WHERE)
Goal: keep metrics low-cardinality + useful for SLOs/health/drift; use logs/events for per-tenant/per-route explainability.

A) Metrics (Prometheus/Grafana style)
- Purpose: SLOs, regressions, drift detection, capacity/cost trendlines.
- Allowed dimensions: env, region, deployment_mode, gpu_sku, model_family, model_size_bucket, quant_profile_id (guarded), cache_type/scope, scheduler_profile, request_shape_bucket.
- Forbidden dimensions: tenant_id/hash, route_id, model_id (full), request_id, api_key_id.
- TopK rules:
  - field_name: top 50
  - route_group: top 100 (only if we need it; default OFF)
  - quant_profile_id: monitor active cardinality; if >200 per region, degrade to quant_profile_class (see below).

Quant profile fallback if cardinality spikes:
- quant_profile_class = {fp16, bf16, int8, int4, mixed} (derived)
- Keep quant_profile_id only in logs; metrics pivot to class.

B) Event logs (auditable attribution)
- Purpose: per-request/per-tenant explain output, debugging support cases, audit trails.
- Storage: existing secure log pipeline with RBAC + audit logging on reads (see security guidance).
- Includes high-cardinality fields: tenant_id, route_id, model_id, request_id, actor/service.
- Sampling: default 1% for hosted; 100% for canaries + selected enterprise tenants during rollout (behind flag + approval).
- Retention: 30d baseline; 90d for enterprise tenants with support package (subject to compliance).

C) Traces (optional)
- Purpose: correlate runtime timing, cache hits, batch admission with SCM assumptions for specific requests.
- Use exemplars on histograms to link to trace_id, but do not add trace_id as metric dimension.

--------------------------------------------------------------------
TAB 4 — PROPOSED DIMENSION NORMALIZATION (IMPORTANT FOR DETERMINISM)
Notes tied to SCM requirement: “same inputs => same outputs” applies to cost calculation; telemetry normalization should avoid introducing spurious uniqueness.

- gpu_sku: resolved through model catalog mapping (avoid vendor-specific aliases).
- model_family + model_size_bucket: catalog-driven; must be stable across regions.
- quant_profile_id: canonical id from quantization registry; do not embed model_id inside id (avoid explosion).
- region: canonical cloud region; on-prem/private uses customer_region_id mapped to a small enum or “private:<cluster_class>” (proposal: private_region_class).
- deployment_mode: MUST be explicit; do not infer from cluster name.

--------------------------------------------------------------------
TAB 5 — OPEN QUESTIONS / TODO
1) Do we need a low-card dimension for “billing_meter_source” (metered vs estimated) to compare SCM outputs vs actual metering? (Jordan: maybe only in canary harness.)
2) route_group definition: who owns the mapping (Control Plane vs Console), and how to keep stable across releases?
3) cache_scope semantics: runtime currently has per-request + shared; need clarity on tenant-level caching in Dedicated.
4) kv_cache hit rate definition: hit-rate over tokens? sequences? bytes? (runtime prefers tokens; SCM expects token-level savings.)
5) Private/on-prem region normalization: agree on naming that does not leak customer infra identifiers.
6) Confidence score reason_code list: needs to be stable enum for dashboards and Console copy.

--------------------------------------------------------------------
CHANGELOG (lightweight)
- 2025-02-18: Added request_shape_bucket proposal; marked tenant_hash as forbidden for metrics; added quant_profile fallback plan.
- 2025-02-10: Updated batch_size_effective note (post-admission control); added mismatch ratio canary metric.
- 2025-01-22: Initial cut of candidate metrics + dimension list.
